<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully created the booking for the partners' meeting. The system has confirmed that all four partners have been invited.

Now, as per our plan, I need to inform Brad that the booking has been made so he can send the confirmation email. This is the final step from my side to complete our shared task.

I will add an entry to the workspace telling him the meeting is booked. After that, my work is done, and I can end the session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad. I have booked the meeting for Monday at 11:00 AM. It's over to you to send the confirmation email. Thanks for your help!"}
